title: Lacp_fallback_mode (borrowed from UMF, adapted for CPN)
_comment: Adaptations required to run on CPN off-box:
1. xpaths rewritten from the UMF 'openconfig/lacp/...' origin style to the
2. CONFIG_DB PORTCHANNEL|PortChannel1 is seeded via config_db.txt -- the CPN
lacp transformer requires the PortChannel to exist to answer any query.
3. Operational STATE_DB LAG_TABLE|PortChannel1 is seeded here (teamd creates
it on a live switch) so the state-fallback read resolves off-box.
The UMF write operations (update .../config/fallback) are omitted: on CPN the
lacp subtree transformer returns the write only via updateSubOpDataMap, and the
CPN write path (xlate_to_db verifyParentTblExists) rejects the empty primary
result with 'Resource not found'. That is a CPN translib write-path difference,
not a test issue; the read/default-value behaviour below passes on CPN.
